responsibility: Build-system fragment for generated Ada front-end sources in gcc/ada. It defines make rules and helper variables to synthesize compiler-owned files such as seinfo/einfo/sinfo tables, name tables, and the generated sdefault body from templates or Ada generator programs, then installs them with move-if-change semantics. Unlike the tiny wrapper Makefile.in, this file owns the dependency graph and regeneration procedure for GNAT source artifacts that are produced at build time rather than kept directly in the tree.
